title: DOE-01: GAO-23-104661 Recommendation 1 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-23-104661 Recommendation 1 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is Promised; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: April 2026.
Response artifact: Life-cycle cost estimate. NNSA had not completed a conforming estimate; GAO reports a revised expected date of December 2026.
Artifact availability: Not yet completed or publicly linked on the GAO page.
Named milestone: December 2026; milestone state: Future monitor.
Remaining gap: A complete estimate aligned with GAO cost-estimating best practices.

Continuation rule: Recheck the official GAO page after the December 2026 estimate milestone. Preserve DOE-01 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOE-01 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
